en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large timber pavilion with ornate wooden framing, tall central tower, and smaller turrets. In front are walks, benches, potted trees, and people strolling or sitting, suggesting an exhibition or fairground setting. At the top in red Hungarian text it reads about a national exhibition in Pécs and identifies the building as the forestry pavilion.
